SELECT c.id, c.name, c.address, c.lat, c.lng, c.rating, c.review_count AS reviewCount, c.price_level AS priceLevel, ST_Distance_Sphere(c.location, ST_SRID(POINT(#{lng},#{lat}),4326)) AS distanceM FROM cafes c
ST_Distance_Sphere(c.location, ST_SRID(POINT(#{lng},#{lat}),4326)) <= #{radius}
AND (c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%') OR c.address LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%'))
AND c.id IN ( SELECT ct.cafe_id FROM cafe_tag ct WHERE ct.tag_id IN #{tid} GROUP BY ct.cafe_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ct.tag_id) = #{tagCount} )
ORDER BY c.rating DESC, c.review_count DESC
ORDER BY ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM checkins ci WHERE ci.cafe_id = c.id AND ci.created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 2 HOUR) ) DESC, c.rating DESC
ORDER BY distanceM ASC
LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id FROM tags WHERE name IN #{n}
